AI Tell Cleaner

Strip the AI "tells" out of writing - or check whether something was AI-written.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Two modes for dealing with AI fingerprints in writing:

  • Clean - takes text you wrote and removes the AI-sounding patterns so it reads like a person, keeping your voice. It also strips authorship/tool metadata from .docx and .pdf files.
  • Detect - takes text of unknown origin and gives an honest report on how likely it was AI-generated, with a confidence band and cited evidence. Never a bare yes/no verdict.

When to use it

When a draft (yours or one Claude produced) sounds robotic and you want it to read human, or when you need a defensible read on whether some text was written by AI. Not for defeating AI detectors or hiding authorship.

How to trigger it

"remove the AI tells"

"humanize this"

"make this sound like me"

"is this AI-written?"

"AI detection report"

Requirements

What this skill needs in order to run. Added 2026-08-20.

Skills - None.

Connectors / MCP servers - None. Works on pasted text or files you provide.

Folder access - Read access to any .md, .txt, .docx or .pdf you hand it, and write access wherever the cleaned output is saved for longer pieces.

KB modules / context files - references/ai-tells.md - bundled with the skill and read first; the 12 linguistic tells, 5 structural tells, vocabulary list and locked voice rules come from it.

Repos - None.

If something is missing - A missing bundled reference is LOUD - the skill reads it before working. Missing pikepdf for PDF metadata stripping is LOUD and reported with the install command. The SILENT risk is scope: it will not defeat AI detectors or pass AI work off as human, and it says so rather than quietly complying.
